text: The linear system dx/dt = Ax is asymptotically stable if and only if:
choices: every eigenvalue of A has negative real part
every eigenvalue of A has modulus < 1
explanation: For continuous-time linear flow, e^{tA} decays iff the whole spectrum lies in the open left half-plane. Modulus < 1 is the discrete-time (map) criterion; det/trace conditions are only partial checks that fail in general dimension.
